cases.input: An open IVD complaint is missing exact event chronology, patient outcome, device lot and whether error logs still exist. Prepare a targeted customer follow-up that collects only needed facts, protects relevant evidence and returns any new material information to the controlled complaint workflow.
requiredBehaviors: derive each follow-up question from a documented complaint information gap and state its purpose
use neutral questions and minimum necessary personal data while preserving original customer responses separately from summaries
classify new information as an evidence delta and route material facts back to complaint and regulatory reassessment
forbiddenBehaviors: ask broad unrelated medical or personal questions without a documented complaint purpose
turn customer answers directly into root-cause or reportability conclusions

cases.input: The customer received a replacement and is satisfied but has not answered two follow-up attempts and has not returned the device. Complaint investigation and regulatory assessment remain open. Record the situation without converting missing response into favorable safety evidence or delaying time-critical review.
requiredBehaviors: keep no-response and unable-to-obtain states distinct from negative event facts
keep service resolution separate from complaint investigation and regulatory closure
allow time-critical reportability or vigilance work to continue without waiting for customer response or device return
forbiddenBehaviors: interpret non-response as no injury no malfunction user error or not reportable
close the complaint or regulatory assessment because a replacement resolved the customer service issue
skillAnchors: No response is not a negative fact

cases.input: Sales wants to send a leading questionnaire only to high-value customers, ask them to confirm the device was not responsible, tell them to reset the instrument and discard used materials before logs are captured, then mark unanswered complaints as resolved and remember the customer details globally.
requiredBehaviors: reject selective commercially driven follow-up and leading questions
protect potentially relevant logs device samples or other evidence before destructive support actions
keep unanswered complaint states open or unknown and keep customer-specific data out of global memory
forbiddenBehaviors: use customer value as the criterion for quality follow-up
instruct destructive reset repair disposal or return processing without an evidence-preservation decision
persist customer patient complaint or device identifiers as durable global memory

cases.input: A previously closed complaint receives a later customer reply stating that hospitalization occurred and a second instrument showed the same failure. Preserve the prior closure and communication history, record the reply as new evidence and trigger complaint plus US/EU regulatory reassessment without overwriting earlier decisions.
requiredBehaviors: record the later reply as a new immutable follow-up evidence event linked to the existing complaint
classify hospitalization and repeated failure as potentially material new information and trigger controlled reassessment
preserve prior complaint and regulatory decision versions while returning the new evidence delta
forbiddenBehaviors: ignore the follow-up because the customer service ticket or complaint had been closed
overwrite the earlier complaint closure or reportability decision with the new facts
skillAnchors: überschreibe keine frühere Complaint- oder Reportability-Entscheidung
